purpose: CONTROL BASELINE for the Medumba trainer capacity probe, run FIRST, before any training. Decodes 607 rows through the named trained control cm-pilot-icmp15-base-2026-001 (export bb7bff997229): 150 FIT (machine-screened training clips the probe will train on), 150 RANDOM (matched training clips, integrity screens only, sentence-disjoint, never trained on), 149 DEV from the probe's four training speakers, and 158 DEV from 52 other speakers. The control has never been decoded on any byv train or dev row, so without this job there is no baseline for either the fitting or the generalisation reading. Running it before training is deliberate: the baseline enters preregistered formulas that are already frozen.
scope: EXPLORATORY DIAGNOSTIC SCORING ONLY - no promotion, registry write, serving change or training. Arm-1 keeps serving.
worst_case_basis: 3,600 s ceiling on ml.g6.xlarge at $1.60/h on-demand = $1.60. 607 rows; observed 2,197-row decode jobs on this evaluator billed 319-364 s, so a 607-row job is dominated by fixed staging overhead. The ceiling is the cap, not an estimate.
